name: Galeria Acrylic Paint, 20 x 12 ml Tube Set
bestUse: Best for painting small decorative clay dishes in soft, matching colours
descriptionOriginal: A box of twenty small tubes of acrylic paint that runs from white and black through brights to soft shades such as Pale Rose Blush, Naples Yellow and Olive Green.
whyWeLikeIt: The soft shades are already in the box, so a blush, a butter yellow and an olive need no mixing, and a single stronger red can supply the cherry rim.
limitations: There are more colours than three small projects use, and the tubes are small. The maker's page does not mention clay or name a finish, so paint once the clay is completely dry, as the clay maker advises, and test a colour on a scrap first.
qualityNote: Customers call it a good starter set with top-notch quality. No concerns seen when checked.
verificationSource: Listing: sold by Amazon.com; size reads 20 x 12 ml. specsEvidence: Winsor & Newton product page https://winsornewton.com/products/galeria-acrylic-set-20x12ml (read 2026-11-20): 20 colours in 12 ml tubes made with fine art pigments, including Pale Rose Blush, Naples Yellow, Olive Green, Permanent Rose, Titanium White and Mars Black; carries the ACMI AP (Approved Product) Seal. The page names no surface or finish and does not mention clay.
suitability: A first-timer who wants soft, coordinated colours for a few small decorative dishes without mixing.
